description: This file contains the implementation of a Chart class within the PHPSpreadsheet library, responsible for reading, parsing, and constructing chart objects from XSLX files, including handling chart elements like axes, series, titles, labels, and styles.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart in a spreadsheet, capable of reading chart XML elements from an XLSX file and constructing corresponding chart objects with axes, series, labels, and styles.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specified attribute from a SimpleXMLElement component, with type formatting (string, integer, boolean, float).

methods.name: readChart
methods.description: Main method to parse chart XML elements and construct a PhpSpreadsheet Chart object, handling various chart components such as axes, titles, series, legends, and styles.

methods.name: chartTitle
methods.description: Constructs a Title object for the chart based on XML details.

methods.name: chartLayoutDetails
methods.description: Extracts layout settings from XML for chart or plot area layout.

methods.name: chartDataSeries
methods.description: Builds a DataSeries object from XML series details, managing series type, points, styles, and trendlines.

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValueSet
methods.description: Creates DataSeriesValues objects for a series, parsing references and cache data.

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValues
methods.description: Extracts numerical or string data points from cache XML for a series.

methods.name: chartDataSeriesValuesMultiLevel
methods.description: Handles multi-level hierarchical series data points.

methods.name: parseRichText
methods.description: Parses rich text elements for chart titles and labels, applying font styles and colors.

methods.name: parseFont
methods.description: Creates a Font object based on XML font style details.

methods.name: readChartAttributes
methods.description: Extracts chart attribute settings such as labels, formats, and effects from XML.

methods.name: setChartAttributes
methods.description: Applies extracted chart attributes to the layout objects.

methods.name: readEffects
methods.description: Reads and applies visual effects like glow, soft edges, and shadows from XML to chart elements.

methods.name: readColor
methods.description: Parses color XML to extract color type, value, alpha, and brightness attributes.

methods.name: readLineStyle
methods.description: Reads and sets line style properties such as width, dash pattern, caps, arrows, and color from XML.

methods.name: setAxisProperties
methods.description: Configures axis properties such as scaling, tick marks, labels, cross position, and text rotation based on XML.
